source: Official programme portals linked per scheme. Eligibility remains subject to current bank/implementing-agency assessment.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free micro-enterprise credit across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k–₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L–₹10L) tiers.
schemes.interest_note: Linked to lender MCLR/repo rate, typically 8.5%–12% per annum.
schemes.collateral_note: No collateral or third-party guarantee required under CGFMU coverage.
how_to_apply: Apply via Udyamimitra portal or visit any commercial, regional rural, or cooperative bank.
Submit business plan with basic KYC and equipment quotations.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy (margin money) up to 25% (general urban) to 35% (special category/women rural) of project cost.
schemes.interest_note: Normal bank commercial rates apply; margin money is held in a 3-year TDR to offset interest.
schemes.collateral_note: Collateral-free under CGTMSE for loans up to ₹10 Lakhs (extendable up to project limit).
how_to_apply: Submit online application on KVIC PMEGP portal.
Application forwarded to District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) and chosen bank.
documents: Caste/Special category certificate if claiming higher subsidy
Educational qualification certificate (8th pass for >₹10L mfg)

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.benefits: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for greenfield enterprises led by SC/ST or women entrepreneurs.
schemes.interest_note: Lowest applicable rate of the bank, not to exceed (MCLR + 3% + tenor premium).
schemes.collateral_note: Primary security on assets financed; collateral security or CGSSI credit guarantee as required by bank.
how_to_apply: Apply directly on Stand-Up Mitra portal or through Lead District Manager (LDM).
documents: Proof of SC/ST or Woman ownership (min 51% stake in enterprise)

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free working capital micro-loan starting at ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.
schemes.interest_note: Subsidized interest rate via direct quarterly DBT to borrower's account.
how_to_apply: Apply online through PM SVANidhi portal or via local Urban Local Body (ULB) / Common Service Centre.
documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation (LoR)

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM / SHG-Bank Linkage Programme
schemes.benefits: Subsidized credit access for Women Self Help Group (SHG) members with interest subvention bringing effective interest down to 7% (or 4% for prompt repayment in selected districts).
schemes.interest_note: 7% effective interest per annum with prompt repayment subvention.
schemes.collateral_note: No collateral or margin money required up to ₹10 Lakh for SHGs.
how_to_apply: Route through Village Organisation (VO) or Cluster Level Federation (CLF) to linked rural/public bank branch.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PM-FME)
schemes.benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per micro food enterprise.
schemes.interest_note: Normal lending bank interest rate applies.
schemes.collateral_note: Covered under CGTMSE for eligible borrowers without additional collateral.
how_to_apply: Register on the national PM-FME portal with District Resource Person (DRP) assistance.
documents: Detailed Project Report for food processing activity

schemes.name: CGTMSE Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises
schemes.benefits: Credit guarantee cover up to 85% for micro-enterprises up to ₹5 Lakhs (and women entrepreneurs), and up to 75%–80% for larger loans up to ₹5 Crore.
schemes.interest_note: Lender commercial interest rate applies plus nominal annual guarantee fee (AGF).
schemes.collateral_note: No collateral or third-party guarantee required; bank obtains guarantee directly from Trust.
how_to_apply: Approach any Member Lending Institution (MLI) including scheduled commercial banks, RRBs, and NBFCs directly.
documents: Past financial records if existing business

schemes.name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP Maharashtra)
schemes.benefits: State government financial assistance with margin money subsidy of 15%–35% for project costs up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹10 Lakh (services).
schemes.collateral_note: No collateral up to ₹10 Lakh; backed by CGTMSE.
how_to_apply: Apply on the official Maha-CMEGP web portal managed by Maharashtra Directorate of Industries.

schemes.name: Annasaheb Patil Arthik Vikas Mahamandal (Interest Subvention)
schemes.benefits: Interest reimbursement up to 12% per annum on term loans up to ₹15 Lakhs for economically backward youth in Maharashtra.
schemes.interest_note: State government reimburses the interest directly to the entrepreneur's account on timely repayment.
how_to_apply: Register on Mahaswayam / Annasaheb Patil Corporation portal and receive Letter of Intent (LOI) before bank sanction.
